mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_instances (instance_id, app_name, profile, host, ip, port, pid, version, status, cpu_load, system_cpu_load, heap_used_mb, heap_max_mb, heap_used_pct, thread_count, qps, error_rate, started_at, last_heartbeat_at) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{appName}, #{profile}, #{host}, #{ip}, #{port}, #{pid}, #{version}, #{status}, #{cpuLoad}, #{systemCpuLoad}, #{heapUsedMb}, #{heapMaxMb}, #{heapUsedPct}, #{threadCount}, #{qps}, #{errorRate}, #{startedAt}, #{lastHeartbeatAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE app_name = VALUES(app_name), profile = VALUES(profile), host = VALUES(host), ip = VALUES(ip), port = VALUES(port), pid = VALUES(pid), version = VALUES(version), status = VALUES(status), cpu_load = VALUES(cpu_load), system_cpu_load = VALUES(system_cpu_load), heap_used_mb = VALUES(heap_used_mb), heap_max_mb = VALUES(heap_max_mb), heap_used_pct = VALUES(heap_used_pct), thread_count = VALUES(thread_count), qps = VALUES(qps), error_rate = VALUES(error_rate), started_at = VALUES(started_at), last_heartbeat_at = VALUES(last_heartbeat_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ops_instances ORDER BY last_heartbeat_at DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ops_metric_snapshots (instance_id, metric_key, metric_value, sample_time) VALUES
(#{s.instanceId}, #{s.metricKey}, #{s.metricValue}, #{s.sampleTime})
mapper.sql: id, name, metric_key, operator, threshold, duration_checks, level, enabled, silence_minutes, channels, description, last_value, last_check_at, firing, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ops_alarm_rules
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR metric_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND enabled = #{enabled}
ORDER BY level ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM ops_alarm_rules WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_alarm_rules (name, metric_key, operator, threshold, duration_checks, level, enabled, silence_minutes, channels, description, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{metricKey}, #{operator}, #{threshold}, #{durationChecks}, #{level}, #{enabled}, #{silenceMinutes}, #{channels}, #{description}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE ops_alarm_rules SET last_value = #{value}, last_check_at = #{time}, firing = #{firing} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: id, rule_id, rule_name, metric_key, metric_value, threshold, level, status, message, fired_at, resolved_at, duration_seconds, ack_by, ack_at, remark, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ops_alarm_records WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND status = 'FIRING' ORDER BY fired_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_alarm_records (rule_id, rule_name, metric_key, metric_value, threshold, level, status, message, fired_at) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{ruleName}, #{metricKey}, #{metricValue}, #{threshold}, #{level}, #{status}, #{message}, #{firedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ops_alarm_records SET ack_by = #{ackBy}, ack_at = #{time}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FIRING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firing, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FIRING' AND level = 'P0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firingP0, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FIRING' AND level = 'P1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firingP1, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FIRING' AND level = 'P2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firingP2, COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FIRING' AND ack_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unacked FROM ops_alarm_records WHERE fired_at >= #{from}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fired_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS bucket, COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'P0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p0, SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'P1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p1, SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'P2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p2 FROM ops_alarm_records WHERE fired_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC
mapper.sql: id, job_code, job_name, cron, handler, job_type, params, enabled, last_status, last_run_at, next_run_at, last_duration_ms, last_message, run_count, fail_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ops_jobs
AND (job_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND enabled = #{enabled}
ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM ops_jobs WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM ops_jobs WHERE job_code = #{jobCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_jobs (job_code, job_name, cron, handler, job_type, params, enabled) VALUES (#{jobCode}, #{jobName}, #{cron}, #{handler}, #{jobType}, #{params}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE ops_jobs SET last_status = #{status}, last_run_at = #{lastRunAt}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, last_duration_ms = #{durationMs}, last_message = #{message}, run_count = run_count + 1, fail_count = fail_count + 1 fail_count = fail_count WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ops_jobs SET next_run_at = #{nextRunAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ops_jobs SET last_status = 'RUNNING', last_run_at = #{lastRunAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enabled, SUM(CASE WHEN last_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(run_count) AS runTotal, SUM(fail_count) AS failTotal FROM ops_jobs
WHERE (last_run_at IS NULL OR last_run_at >= #{from})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_job_records (job_id, job_code, status, trigger_type, instance_id, start_at) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{jobCode}, #{status}, #{triggerType}, #{instanceId}, #{startAt})
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(error_code, -1) AS errorCode, IFNULL(error_message, '未知') AS errorMessage, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM ai_tasks WHERE status = 3 AND created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY error_code, error_message ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sampleCount, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, finished_at) / 1000) AS avgMs, MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, finished_at) / 1000) AS maxMs FROM ai_tasks WHERE started_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at >= started_at AND created_at >= #{from}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users
AND created_at >= #{from}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM works WHERE is_public = 1 AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM refunds WHERE status = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_reports WHERE status = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(1) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2) THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amountCents FROM orders WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM uploads
AND created_at >= #{from}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM uploads
AND created_at >= #{from}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(1) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(size_bytes), 0) AS sizeBytes FROM uploads WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM admin_logs WHERE created_at >= #{from}) AS adminLogs, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM audit_logs WHERE created_at >= #{from}) AS auditLogs, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM audit_logs WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND check_result = 'block') AS blocked, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM audit_logs WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND check_result = 'report') AS reported

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_configs (config_key, config_value, description, is_public, updated_by) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description}, 0, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), description = VALUES(description), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)

INSERT INTO system_configs (config_key, config_value, description, is_public, updated_by) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description}, 0, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), description = IFNULL(VALUES(description), description), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)
mapper.select: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS tableName, TABLE_ROWS AS tableRows, IFNULL(DATA_LENGTH, 0) AS dataLength, IFNULL(INDEX_LENGTH, 0) AS indexLength, IFNULL(DATA_FREE, 0) AS dataFree, ENGINE AS engine, TABLE_COLLATION AS collation FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = #{schema} ORDER BY (IFNULL(DATA_LENGTH, 0) + IFNULL(INDEX_LENGTH, 0)) DESC
